messages:
Ana M (Marketing): Heads up — TidalWave marketplace listing goes live next week. Need a co-marketing playbook: launch post, benchmark blog, joint webinar, and inbound lead routing. Who owns what? :rocket:
Liam (PMM): I can own the benchmark narrative + webinar outline. Thinking 30m talk + 15m demo/Q&A.
Sophia (Partner): TidalWave ok for partner rep + a customer speaker. Prefer Tue or Wed morning PT.
Jordan (Sales): For inbound: assign marketplace leads to 'partners-inbound' queue and tag them with partner and campaign. Can we add an AE notification and auto-assign to partner SDR pool?
Ana M (Marketing): Routing rules example (pseudo-rule for ops):
```
if lead.source == 'marketplace' and lead.partner == 'TidalWave':
  lead.tag.add('tw_marketplace_2026')
  lead.assign(queue='partners-inbound')
  notify(['sales_oncall', 'tidal-sdr'])
```
Liam (PMM): Nice — add lead_score +10 for demo signups. Also gather p50/p95 latency + cost excerpt for the blog. I'll coordinate with eng-ml.
Sophia (Partner): We'll deliver partner logo, co-mail HTML, and one customer quote by Friday EOD.
deploy-bot: Webinar landing page template deployed to staging: /marketing/webinars/tidalwave — preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/webinars/tidalwave
Jordan (Sales): ABM plan: target infra + platform leads, 1:1 outreach from partner SDRs, and automated nurture from our side. I'll prep seed list and share tomorrow.
Ana M (Marketing): Draft subject lines for invites (choose 1-2 for A/B):
- "See Redwood + TidalWave: Faster, cheaper LLM inference in your cloud"
- "Live demo: unified inference with TidalWave marketplace"
- "How to cut LLM latency — Redwood x TidalWave walkthrough"
Liam (PMM): Leaning toward #1 + #2 split for A/B. For the blog intro, we'll lead with a quick benchmark snippet and link to full results.
Sophia (Partner): We can co-sponsor paid social. Partner will also send co-mail to existing customers.
Ana M (Marketing): Promo cadence: social + blog on launch day, webinar invite 7/3 days before, reminder 1 day before, partner co-mail same day as launch. Assets timeline: drafts due Wed, landing page + CTAs live Fri.
Jordan (Sales): Add tag 'tw_marketplace_2026' to all leads and sync to SFDC campaign "TW Marketplace Launch". Also create an AE alert via Slack for >70 lead score.
Liam (PMM): Quick checklist for the benchmark table (eng-ml): model, tokens, p50/p95 latency, cost per 1M tokens, quantization config. Will request numbers today.
Ana M (Marketing): Visuals — need hero banner (1200x600), thumbnail, and a short 1-sentence partner pitch for marketplace listing. Suggestions below:
1) "Ship LLMs faster with unified inference + TidalWave"
2) "Lower latency, lower cost: Redwood + TidalWave in your cloud"
3) "Production-ready LLM inference across clouds"
Sophia (Partner): We'll provide brand guidelines and a hero asset by Thurs.
Jordan (Sales): For inbound workflow, sample SFDC flow: create lead -> add tw tag -> push to campaign -> assign to partners-inbound queue -> workflow rule notifies slack channel #tw-inbound.
Ana M (Marketing): Who can own the webinar copy and landing page? Liam you do benchmark copy, I'll do landing + CTAs, Jordan handle ABM copy.
Liam (PMM): Taking webinar slides + blog benchmark. Will open a draft in the launch board.
Sophia (Partner): Confirmed: partner PR team will help amplify on announcement day.
Ana M (Marketing): OK — sync meeting 11:00am PT tomorrow to hand off assets. I'll create a calendar invite. :calendar: 
Liam (PMM): Adding tasks to the launch board now: https://app.asana.com/0/123456789/987654321
Jordan (Sales): I'll share the seed ABM list by EOD tomorrow.
Ana M (Marketing): Thanks everyone — great momentum. :thumbsup:
